name: Cody Rhodes

titleSummary.name: ROH World Six-Man Tag Team Championship

summary: Rhodes’s career bridges WWE, the independent circuit, NJPW and AEW. His championship résumé connects his early tag-team years with his later run as a world champion.

promotionPeriods.name: OVW
promotionPeriods.note: WWE developmental territory at the time. This bracket begins with an early match recorded by OWW, not a claim about his exact professional debut. OVW appearances overlapped his move to WWE television.

promotionPeriods.name: WWE
promotionPeriods.note: Starts with his main-roster television introduction. His first Raw match followed on July 16, 2007. Ends with WWE’s announced release; his earlier developmental period is shown separately as OVW.

promotionPeriods.name: ROH
promotionPeriods.note: From Final Battle 2016 through his final ROH television taping in December 2018. This run overlapped NJPW and other bookings.

promotionPeriods.name: AEW
promotionPeriods.note: Starts at the company’s launch, including his executive role. His first AEW match was Double or Nothing on May 25, 2019. Ends at the public departure announcement, not his final match.

promotionPeriods.name: WWE
promotionPeriods.note: Public return at WrestleMania 38. The open end extends through this site’s career archive date; it is not a future contract end date.

promotionPeriods.name: NJPW
promotionPeriods.note: Starts with the video introduction announcing him for NJPW / Bullet Club. His first NJPW match was January 4, 2017; his final match was Wrestle Kingdom 13 on January 4, 2019.

promotionPeriods.name: TNA
promotionPeriods.note: From his Bound for Glory introduction through his last televised Impact match. The end is the broadcast date; taping dates can differ.

promotionPeriods.name: GFW
promotionPeriods.fullName: Global Force Wrestling · appearances / title run
promotionPeriods.note: The profile’s GFW period includes appearances and NEX*GEN title defenses on other promotions’ cards. It does not indicate an exclusive GFW contract or continuous GFW touring.

promotionPeriods.name: WCPW
promotionPeriods.note: Span of the matches listed on the promotion’s archived roster page, from Refuse to Lose through the Pro Wrestling World Cup Mexican qualifier. These are recorded appearances, not verified contract dates.

promotionPeriods.name: Independents
promotionPeriods.note: Overview of his 2016–2018 independent period, beginning at EVOLVE 66. Includes EVOLVE, PWG, Northeast Wrestling, DEFY, wXw, and other bookings. December 31 is a plotting boundary for the reported end year, not a final match or contract date. This is not an exhaustive list; later guest appearances are not represented.

profile.intro: Known as “The American Nightmare,” Cody Rhodes is a second-generation American wrestler, the son of Dusty Rhodes and younger half-brother of Dustin Rhodes.

legacyHtml.biography:
Known as “The American Nightmare,” Cody Rhodes is a second-generation American wrestler, the son of Dusty Rhodes and younger half-brother of Dustin Rhodes.

Career in brief

After his first WWE run, he rebuilt his career across the independent circuit, ROH and NJPW, co-promoted All In and helped launch AEW. Returning to WWE in 2022, he completed his pursuit of its world championship at WrestleMania XL in 2024.
